items.question: Has revenue on engagements spanning the year end been tested for the stage of completion, and unbilled work in progress valued and supported by time records?
Has work in progress and unbilled fees been agreed to contracts, timesheets or milestones, and tested for recoverability?
Have fees invoiced in advance been identified and deferred where the service has not been delivered by the reporting date?
Have fees from and payments to related parties or the owners been identified and tested?
Has staff cost been reconciled to payroll records and to the cost recovery assumptions used for fee recognition?
